finding: How the JWT is checked is not written down; the OpenAPI file only says bearerFormat JWT
mitigation: Verify signature with Entra keys; accept RS256 only; reject alg none; check issuer audience and expiry; reject tokens over 3600 s; test with forged and expired tokens

finding: GET /books/{bookId}/loans lets any member read any book's loan history (e.g. GET /books/1042/loans with another member's token); books also reachable across buildings by ID
mitigation: Ownership check inside the query (JOIN books ON owner_id = caller); add building_id check; return 404 for not-yours

finding: Search text goes into a SQL query that is not shown to be parameterised; member text goes into HTML digest emails
mitigation: Parameterised LIKE; database login with select/insert/update only; escape member text in email templates; reject < and > when saving

finding: The design does not say where the database, Redis, Service Bus, Blob and email secrets are stored
mitigation: Key Vault with managed identity; managed identity itself for SQL, Blob and Service Bus; no .env in production; rotate every 90 days

finding: App Service has its own public address and can be called directly, skipping the Front Door firewall and limits
mitigation: Access restriction to the AzureFrontDoor.Backend tag plus a check of the X-Azure-FDID header

finding: Fake API sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin * (ZAP Medium) and replies carry no cache rules (ZAP Informational); TLS settings not specified
mitigation: HTTPS only, TLS 1.2 minimum; no CORS headers or an exact list; Cache-Control no-store on user-specific replies

finding: No per-member limits; one account can flood owners with borrow requests, notifications and emails
mitigation: 10 new requests per hour and 3 open per owner per member; 30 listings per day; 20 photo uploads per hour; return 429 with Retry-After

finding: Logs can capture request bodies and Authorization tokens; queue messages carry member email addresses
mitigation: Single logging function with allow-listed fields; no bodies, headers, search text, tokens, addresses, phones or emails; queue messages hold memberId and book IDs only
